method.ignore_definition: capture tick with nearest material <=150u AND dot(teacher.action, vec_to_nearest_material) < 0
method.damage_method: full-stream hp drops between consecutive captures within the same wave (player_damage events are too sparse to use: 4 events vs 76 hp in run_1784913937_22390)
method.threat_contexts: exclusive priority d_boss > c_projectiles > b_enemies > a_clear; overlays proj300/boss are non-exclusive

truncation.verdict: dropped_counts.materials is hardcoded to 0 in the mod and carries NO information; but the capture path is genuinely uncapped (adapter emits the full _golds list), so there is no capture-side truncation. The 50-53 ceiling is game-side.

wave_end_fate.verdict: every wave ends with 0 on-ground materials and 0 instance ids carrying over; the end-of-wave auto-collect vacuums the field
